vb_textbox.text: It's hard to tell exactly what the strategy is – I think the brown gnome is often the best gnome. But what I would do is stick with high rewarding gnomes until they started to drop below 5 or 4, then I would try the other colour gnome. If that was higher than the last one, I would stick with that colour. Repeat the colours to yourself to remember "brown and green, brown and green" or "brown and purple" or "purple and red". It seemed to me that brown and green/purple and red were often profitable in pairs. Good luck!
